remarks:
Welcome to this charming ranch-style home situated on over half an acre in the Town of Olean! Offering the ease and convenience of one-floor living, this home features 2 bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, a spacious living room, dedicated dining room, and first-floor laundry.

The functional layout provides comfortable living space throughout, with the living room offering a welcoming place to relax and the dining room providing plenty of room for everyday meals or entertaining. Both bedrooms, the full bathroom, and laundry are conveniently located on the main level, making day-to-day living simple and efficient.

The full basement offers an abundance of additional space for storage, a workshop, hobbies, or the potential for additional usable space. Outside, the property sits on over half an acre, providing a spacious yard with plenty of room to enjoy. A back patio creates a great spot for grilling, outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing and enjoying the surroundings.

Completing the property is a detached 2-car garage with plenty of room for vehicles, lawn equipment, tools, and additional storage. With its convenient ranch-style layout, first-floor laundry, full basement, generous yard, back patio, and detached garage, this Town of Olean home has plenty to offer its next owner!
